{{Quote|I christen this ship&hellip;the ''Executor''!|Darth Vader, following the destruction of Laakteen Depot|<ref name="It's a Trap" />}}
The '''destruction of Laakteen Depot''' marked the maiden voyage of the newly-constructed [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. The ''Executor'' completely destroyed [[Laakteen Depot]], an outpost the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] fought a year to win. The outpost's destruction effectively acted as the ''Executor''{{'s}} commencement ceremony, under Vader's orders. After word of its destruction was brought to the Rebel Base at Yavin 4, the Rebels were forced to form an alliance with the Mon Calamari.
